testCases.title: Verify category page displays the correct products and title
steps: Navigate to the category name on the main page.
Observe the category page that loads.
expectedResults: The title of the category page matches the clicked category name.
The products relevant to the selected category are displayed correctly.

testCases.title: Ensure filters, sorting options, and pagination controls are present on category page
steps: Navigate to the category page as per test case TC-001.
Inspect the presence of filter options.
Inspect the presence of sorting options.
Inspect the presence of pagination controls.
expectedResults: Filters are available for users to select.
Sorting options are available for users to choose from.
Pagination controls are present for browsing through products.
